summary.text: Rick Roth is the Republican candidate for Florida State Senate District 26 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat David Silvers in a race with no incumbent.
A former Republican member of the Florida House of Representatives, he owned an agriculture business.

paragraphs.text: Rick Roth was born in West Palm Beach, Florida, and earned a B.S. from Emory University.
His career experience includes owning a business in agriculture, and he has served on the boards of the Florida Fruit & Vegetable Association and the Western Palm Beach County Farm Bureau.
Roth won election to the Florida House of Representatives District 85 in 2016 and was re-elected there in 2018 and 2020, then won District 94 in 2022.
He left the House on November 5, 2024, and his committee assignments in his final term included State Affairs and Ways and Means.
He advanced from the canceled August 18, 2026 Republican primary for Senate District 26.
